gloss: to jump up and down; to hop; to bounce

definitions.gloss: to jump up and down; to hop; to bounce around
definitions.explanation: To make repeated jumping or hopping movements, typically expressing excitement, joy, or energetic movement.
For liquid or small particles to jump or fly up, as when something is dropped into water or when cooking oil splatters.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{喜|よろこ}んで{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねていた。
examples.english: The children were jumping up and down with joy.

examples.japanese: うさぎが{野原|のはら}を{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねている。
examples.english: A rabbit is hopping around in the field.

examples.japanese: {油|あぶら}が{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねて{服|ふく}についた。

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる → {飛|と}び{跳|は}ねない (negative)
・{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる → {飛|と}び{跳|は}ねて (te-form)
・{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる → {飛|と}び{跳|は}ねた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {飛|と}ぶ (to jump/fly) + {跳|は}ねる (to leap/splash)

The combination emphasizes lively, repeated jumping movements.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{嬉|うれ}しくて{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to jump for joy
・ピョンピョン{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to hop around
・{元気|げんき}に{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to bounce around energetically

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{跳|は}ねる - to jump; to splash (single movement)
・ぴょんぴょん{跳|と}ぶ - to hop (onomatopoeic)
